outline:
This course aims to introduce the fundamental principles of digital communication systems. The course contains the following topics:

1. Introduction
2. Deterministic and Random Signal Analysis
3. Digital Modulation Schemes
4. Optimum Receivers for AWGN Channels
5. An Introduction to Information Theory
schedule:
Week 01. Compensatory holiday for Peace Memorial Day
Week 02. Introduction, Deterministic and Random Signal Analysis
Week 03. Deterministic and Random Signal Analysis
Week 04. Deterministic and Random Signal Analysis
Week 05. Digital Modulation Schemes
Week 06. Compensatory holiday for Children's Day
Week 07. Digital Modulation Schemes
Week 08. Digital Modulation Schemes
Week 09. Optimum Receivers for AWGN Channels (online class via Google Meet)
Week 10. Labor Day
Week 11. Midterm Exam, Optimum Receivers for AWGN Channels
Week 12. Optimum Receivers for AWGN Channels
Week 13. Optimum Receivers for AWGN Channels
Week 14. Optimum Receivers for AWGN Channels
Week 15. An Introduction to Information Theory
Week 16. An Introduction to Information Theory
Week 17. Dragon Boat Festival
Week 18. Final Exam

The schedule may be adjusted if necessary.
assessment:
Prerequisites: Probability, Signal and Systems, Principles of Communications

Matlab Assignment 30%
Midterm Exam      35%
Final Exam        35%
